Documentation

Crates.

What each published crate and package provides.

Crate What it gives you
lspkit EngineApi and its types, plus the config, vfs and sidecar modules.
lspkit-server JSON-RPC LSP server scaffolding on lsp-types: capabilities, dispatch, URIs, diagnostics, progress, cancellation and live file watching.
lsp-profiler Language-neutral CPU and memory profiler for language servers.
lsp-profiler-dotnet The profiler's .NET runtime, using EventPipe.

Features

Crate Feature Adds
lspkit treesitter Tree-sitter parsing helpers.
lspkit tracing-setup A ready-made tracing subscriber.
lspkit-server mcp The MCP adapter over the same engine.
lspkit-server pull Pull-based incremental analysis with salsa.

Editor package

@nimblesite/lsp-profiler-ui is the VS Code UI for the profiler: processes, CPU heat map, flame graph, memory dashboard and retention graph. It also carries Debug Adapter Protocol glue for extension tests.

npm install @nimblesite/lsp-profiler-ui

The foundation for any language's tooling.
